scientific_role: Frozen simulator-based integration baseline for the first PRAISE I-M experiment. M1-v2 consumes the same public rho-conditioned I1 as M0, performs a public-I1-only inverse lift to one native surrogate process per provider, then composes those surrogates in native AICon/YAFS G0.
freeze_rule: Do not retune or enrich M1-v2 to improve the observed G0 white-box result. Reopen only for a concrete implementation or scientific defect. New integration ideas belong to M2.

diagnostic_interpretation.M1: systematically optimistic and near-saturated at graph level after short horizons
diagnostic_interpretation.main_observation: The selected point inverse lifts generate a graph request distribution that is substantially faster and cheaper than the WB graph process, especially in latency tails, even though native composition semantics are correct.
diagnostic_interpretation.first_M2_gate: Test whether substantially different theta_i vectors with similarly good public-I1 reconstruction loss produce materially different graph-level sigma. If yes, preserve inverse ambiguity; if no, enrich the latent process family while keeping the same I1 information boundary.
